note: The `*_ascii_copyable_count` fields are semantic views over the exact vulnerable-original approx-copy predicate `ucsout[j] < 0x80`: Stage 04 counts how many entries in the current `ucsout[0..ucsoutlen)` block satisfy that source predicate immediately before and during the vulnerable `if (approx) { for (j = 0; j < ucsoutlen; j++) { if (ucsout[j] < 0x80) out[outpos++] = ucsout[j]; } }` loop. `utf8_message_gate.zero_literal` is intentionally omitted because `*.zero_literal` is treated as a compile-time literal.
